issues.title: Reservation: level units being matched by an agent - Contributor coordination
issues.author: llesieur99
issues.body:
Contributor coordination
This issue is the shared coordination noticeboard for matching work in this repository: it exists so that contributors and their AI agents do not duplicate each other's work.
It is a lightweight noticeboard only — not a task queue, campaign register, reservation database, match proof, or a source of truth for completed work. The repository and master remain authoritative.
Every active contributor keeps one comment

issues.title: Archived: matching blocker notes moved to the shared document
issues.author: llesieur99
issues.body:
Retired tracker — knowledge moved to the repository
The maintained reference is docs/MATCHING-BLOCKERS.md. Every contributor can edit any entry through a normal pull request; discussion belongs in the relevant code or documentation PR.
The 52 numbered observations and both contributor measurement sets were preserved in PR #290. Existing comments and issue history remain available as provenance.
This issue is closed because the tracker was replaced, not because every technical blocker is solved.…
